change: LAG/LEAD IGNORE NULLS use monotone current/target cursors and a count of non-null values between them. Target values are borrowed, not copied. Advancing the current row removes one boundary value from the count; advancing the target finds new values. No offset-sized ring or per-row value directory is allocated.
complexity: At most two value-expression reads per input row, with constant auxiliary state excluding returned output. Empty, all-null, sparse and dense partitions and offsets larger than the partition use the same contract. Offset zero directly reads the current value.
otherRemovals: Ranking and positional functions operate directly on WindowRow entries or partition length. The unconditional partition-to-source-row array is gone; percent_rank normalizes its existing rank output array in place. Offset functions read WindowRow.row only as required.

evidence.method: Sparse non-null values with offset 3; independent slice/filter oracle; two warmups and three timed local samples; construction and validation excluded; compiled backend hashes record executed code.

edgeCases: Independent lag/lead oracle for 0/1/128 rows, all-null/sparse/dense values, null-respecting and null-ignoring modes, offsets 0/1/2/5/31/200/MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and per-row default expressions.
Getter counts enforce at most two value reads per source row.
Ranking, row_number and ntile run with a throwing source-row getter, proving they need only precomputed keys and positions.

Real flba12_timestamp.parquet HTTP 206/ignored-range 200 queries now verify lag and lead over signed wide timestamps. Concurrent 64/128 MiB R2 queries verify lag over 1024-byte text along with existing window outputs and cache cleanup.
limits: This assumes immutable input rows and deterministic expressions, as the window execution contract does. Returned arrays, retained input materialization and whole-runtime heap accounting remain separate unfinished work. No cloud-latency or total Cloudflare-memory guarantee is inferred from local kernel timings. Decimal and ALP/BSON/BROTLI gaps remain open.
